finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 11; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A supersession whose derived closure includes an accepted outcome, left unreopened.
why: Section 12.5 row 11, R-G06 and AX-M1-02. The mutation deletes the conjunct binding the reopened set to the closure, leaving both sets present and the walk marked complete -- so a supersession may record a closure containing an accepted outcome and a reopen set authored beside it rather than from it.
